_doc: Edits of the landmark registry (P2-005, DELHI_WORLD.md 1 'Data files', LS2): what a person or a builder read and decided, kept apart from the generated files so a rebuild never loses it. The registry build (node tools/bake/landmarks/build.mjs) lays every edit on top of the joined sources; an edit wins over the owner list and the score. 'target' names the landmark by id: the registry id, the Wikidata id or the OSM id. action 'set' sets the fields in 'set' (tier, name, type, era, height_m with height_source and height_evidence, lat and lon with position_evidence, position_checked to settle a source disagreement, join_checked to settle a name match, footprint to take another OSM object or a ring read from a photo or satellite view in place of the OSM shape, front, extent, references); action 'remove' takes the landmark out (it is listed under 'rejected' in the build report with the reason). 'why' is the evidence line: what was read, where and when. Where OSM and photos disagree on a footprint or a height, the edit takes the photo or satellite evidence and says so (owner rule, 2026-11-13). An edit whose target is not found is listed as stale in the report and stays here.

set.height_evidence: hero road spec harness/data/hero_roads/cp_inner_circle.json colonnadeEdge blockHeight 11.5 m (photo refs cp_block_2010, cp_colonnade_2013) and the area sheet cp_inner_circle 'Buildings' (two storey blocks, each about 11.5 m high); en.wikipedia 'Connaught Place, New Delhi' rev 1378186633, read 2026-11-13: 'the present two-storied structure with an open colonnade'
set.position_evidence: the area centroid of OSM way/164675825 Rajiv Chowk Central Park (28.6328058, 77.2197100, osmBase 2026-11-11), the middle of the rings: the OSM centre lines of Inner Circle, Middle Circle and Outer Circle stay 123 to 131 m, 234 to 236 m and 308 to 328 m from it, so the centre holds to about 4 m; Wikidata Q2341950 P625 is 3.3 m from it

extent.source: median distance from the centre to the OSM road centre line nodes named Inner Circle (58 nodes), Middle Circle (91) and Outer Circle or Connaught Circus (118), osmBase 2026-11-11
extent.note: the hero is the rings of colonnaded blocks around the park out to the Outer Circle; the footprint way is only its middle. Rajiv Chowk metro station lies under the park (underground class, no shell)

edits.why: hand check of the first hero: position, ring radii and block height read from the OSM extract, the hero road spec and the area sheet
